svg.title: Glance-Port — Your screen. A closer connection.
svg.desc: Screen sharing, audio and attended remote control for Windows, macOS and Android. A colourful plum, rose, coral and gold design with the supplied Glance-Port logo.

g.text: A SHARED SPACE. A HUMAN CONNECTION.
SHARE A VIEW. FIND YOUR FLOW.
Screen sharing, audio and remote assistance.
One invitation. A shared space to work together.
OPEN SOURCE · INVITATION ROOMS · CONTROL WITH PERMISSION
